panels.title: Days since the last band night

targets.rawSql: SELECT current_date - max(wake_date) FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2'

panels.title: Beats corrected, last band night (over 5% = poor)

targets.rawSql: SELECT rr_corrected_share FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' ORDER BY wake_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT hrv_rmssd_milli FROM daily_outcomes WHERE outcome_scored ORDER BY local_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT rmssd_sleep_ms FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' ORDER BY wake_date DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: HRV, RMSSD over the night (ms). Different definitions: compare trends, not values

targets.rawSql: SELECT (local_date + 1)::timestamp AS time, 'WHOOP' AS metric, hrv_rmssd_milli AS value FROM daily_outcomes WHERE outcome_scored AND $__timeFilter((local_date + 1)::timestamp) AND hrv_rmssd_milli IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT wake_date::timestamp, 'Band (ble-nightly-2)', rmssd_sleep_ms FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' AND $__timeFilter(wake_date::timestamp) AND rmssd_sleep_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Resting heart rate (bpm); band: median over the sleep window

targets.rawSql: SELECT (local_date + 1)::timestamp AS time, 'WHOOP' AS metric, resting_heart_rate AS value FROM daily_outcomes WHERE outcome_scored AND $__timeFilter((local_date + 1)::timestamp) AND resting_heart_rate IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT wake_date::timestamp, 'Band (ble-nightly-2)', resting_hr_median FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' AND $__timeFilter(wake_date::timestamp) AND resting_hr_median IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT (local_date + 1)::timestamp AS time, 'WHOOP' AS metric, respiratory_rate AS value FROM daily_outcomes WHERE outcome_scored AND $__timeFilter((local_date + 1)::timestamp) AND respiratory_rate IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT wake_date::timestamp, 'Band (ble-nightly-2)', respiratory_rate FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' AND $__timeFilter(wake_date::timestamp) AND respiratory_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Blood oxygen (%); band field disputed between sources

targets.rawSql: SELECT (local_date + 1)::timestamp AS time, 'WHOOP' AS metric, spo2_percentage AS value FROM daily_outcomes WHERE outcome_scored AND $__timeFilter((local_date + 1)::timestamp) AND spo2_percentage IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT wake_date::timestamp, 'Band (ble-nightly-2)', spo2_mean FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' AND $__timeFilter(wake_date::timestamp) AND spo2_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT (local_date + 1)::timestamp AS time, 'WHOOP' AS metric, skin_temp_celsius AS value FROM daily_outcomes WHERE outcome_scored AND $__timeFilter((local_date + 1)::timestamp) AND skin_temp_celsius IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT wake_date::timestamp, 'Band (ble-nightly-2)', skin_temp_mean_c FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' AND $__timeFilter(wake_date::timestamp) AND skin_temp_mean_c IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Beats corrected per night (over 5% = poor HRV quality)

targets.rawSql: SELECT wake_date::timestamp AS time, rr_corrected_share AS corrected FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' AND $__timeFilter(wake_date::timestamp) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Steps per day (band counter; see the per-cycle check below)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (minute AT TIME ZONE (SELECT local_timezone FROM app_config))::date::timestamp AS time, sum(steps) AS steps FROM ble_minutes WHERE minutes_version = 'ble-minutes-1' AND $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active minutes per day (band: walking or running)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (minute AT TIME ZONE (SELECT local_timezone FROM app_config))::date::timestamp AS time, sum(seconds_walk) / 60.0 AS walking, sum(seconds_run) / 60.0 AS running FROM ble_minutes WHERE minutes_version = 'ble-minutes-1' AND $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average heart rate per WHOOP cycle (cycles the band covered for 95%+)

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.start AS time, 'WHOOP' AS metric, c.average_heart_rate AS value FROM cycles c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.score_state = 'SCORED' AND $__timeFilter(c.start) AND c.average_heart_rate IS NOT NULL AND c."end" IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT sum(seconds_recorded) FROM ble_minutes WHERE minutes_version = 'ble-minutes-1' AND minute >= c.start AND minute < c."end") >= 0.95 * extract(epoch FROM c."end" - c.start) UNION ALL SELECT c.start AS time, 'Band' AS metric, sum(m.hr_mean * m.seconds_with_hr) / nullif(sum(m.seconds_with_hr), 0) AS value FROM cycles c JOIN ble_minutes m ON m.minutes_version = 'ble-minutes-1' AND m.minute >= c.start AND m.minute < c."end" WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.score_state = 'SCORED' AND $__timeFilter(c.start) GROUP BY c.id, c.start, c."end" HAVING sum(m.seconds_recorded) >= 0.95 * extract(epoch FROM c."end" - c.start) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Steps per WHOOP cycle: WHOOP vs the band's two counters (95%+ covered)

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.start AS time, 'WHOOP' AS metric, c.step_count AS value FROM cycles c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.score_state = 'SCORED' AND $__timeFilter(c.start) AND c.step_count IS NOT NULL AND c."end" IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT sum(seconds_recorded) FROM ble_minutes WHERE minutes_version = 'ble-minutes-1' AND minute >= c.start AND minute < c."end") >= 0.95 * extract(epoch FROM c."end" - c.start) UNION ALL SELECT c.start AS time, 'Band step_counter' AS metric, sum(m.steps) AS value FROM cycles c JOIN ble_minutes m ON m.minutes_version = 'ble-minutes-1' AND m.minute >= c.start AND m.minute < c."end" WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.score_state = 'SCORED' AND $__timeFilter(c.start) GROUP BY c.id, c.start, c."end" HAVING sum(m.seconds_recorded) >= 0.95 * extract(epoch FROM c."end" - c.start) UNION ALL SELECT c.start AS time, 'Band hw_step_counter' AS metric, sum(m.steps_hw) AS value FROM cycles c JOIN ble_minutes m ON m.minutes_version = 'ble-minutes-1' AND m.minute >= c.start AND m.minute < c."end" WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.score_state = 'SCORED' AND $__timeFilter(c.start) GROUP BY c.id, c.start, c."end" HAVING sum(m.seconds_recorded) >= 0.95 * extract(epoch FROM c."end" - c.start) ORDER BY 1

SELECT wake_date, sleep_start, sleep_end, round(rr_coverage::numeric, 3) AS rr_coverage, round(rr_corrected_share::numeric, 3) AS corrected, rr_quality_ok, round(rmssd_sleep_ms::numeric, 1) AS rmssd_sleep, round(rmssd_fixed_ms::numeric, 1) AS rmssd_02_06, round(resting_hr_median::numeric, 1) AS resting_hr, round(respiratory_rate::numeric, 1) AS resp_rate, respiratory_windows, round(spo2_mean::numeric, 1) AS spo2, round(skin_temp_mean_c::numeric, 2) AS skin_temp, decoder_version, computed_at FROM ble_nights WHERE metrics_version = 'ble-nightly-2' ORDER BY wake_date DESC LIMIT 30
